responsibility: Implements supplementary explanations and structured suggestions for type and lifetime mismatches, enriching diagnostics with cause-specific notes, associated-type constraint suggestions, and related contextual guidance.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `errors/note_and_explain.rs`, which converts `ty::Region` values into reusable lifetime-explanation subdiagnostics, this file is tied to general inference reporting and interprets concrete `TypeError` and obligation-cause cases. It adds targeted notes and suggestions for mismatched types, closures/async blocks, associated types, and missing bounds rather than just describing regions.
